messages.content: Hi there — this is your weekly Northline Care check-in. How have you been since we last connected? Anything going on with your medications or blood sugar you'd like me to note?

Sort of yeah. I'm down to about 4 days of metformin and the pharmacy says they need a new prescription from my doctor before they'll refill it. Problem is that pharmacy is 45 miles away so it's not exactly a quick errand.

I've logged that. Running low on metformin with a prescription barrier is exactly the kind of thing a nurse needs to look at — I've flagged your case to the care team just now. Fair warning: median response time is currently 31 hours, so hopefully you hear back well before you're out.
Is there anything Northline can do about getting me out there? My truck's been in the shop all week.

I'm sorry you're dealing with that on top of everything else. Transportation isn't something I'm able to arrange — that's outside what this service can do right now. Might be worth calling the pharmacy directly to ask if they have mail-order options or can transfer the script to a closer location once your doctor sends the new one.
Yeah ok. One other thing — my blood sugar this morning was 187, figured I should mention it.

Logged your reading of 187. The nurse picking up your flag will see that alongside the metformin note — it'll all be in the same picture for them. I'll set your next check-in for next week. Hope things ease up a bit.

theme: prescription refill needs a new script, pharmacy is far away
